task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The robot CAR needs to place MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE. The FRONT_CRATE is an obstacle in front of the robot's path. First, navigate to FRONT_CRATE, pick it up, move it to TEMP_ZONE, place it there. Then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, and place the bottle on it.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is a suitable location to temporarily place the FRONT_CRATE
The robot can interact with objects within 2.0 Euclidean distance
After removing the obstacle, the robot can proceed to pick up MEDICINE_BOTTLE and place it on MEDICAL_TABLE
